title: docs(agents): a `-t` name filter is a regex, so a pasted title is a false green (objectui#9731)
body:
Fixes #9731
Clause-②: no

## What this lands

The 9-line prose half of objectui#9660, which was taken out of PR objectui#9730 because `AGENTS.md` is a governed surface. It goes back in **verbatim**, in the vitest-invocation section of `AGENTS.md`, directly after the 「路径过滤零匹配也不再是绿的」 bullet and before the 「确需从包目录启动」 bullet. No other byte of the file moves, and no other file is in the diff.

The placement matters for one phrase: the new text says 「上一条的 `passWithNoTests`」, and the bullet directly above it is the one that introduces `passWithNoTests`.

## Verbatim, measured three ways

- The 9 added lines of this diff (the `+` lines of `git diff`, marker stripped): md5 `0917d860625af10bb0182f26770f12c6`.
- The card's 「The removed text, verbatim」 block (quote marker stripped): md5 `0917d860625af10bb0182f26770f12c6`.
- The 9 lines that commit `7d5e9858c2` on PR objectui#9730 (「revert(docs): drop the AGENTS.md note from this branch」) took out: md5 `0917d860625af10bb0182f26770f12c6`. That commit took them out of this same spot, between the same two bullets.
- The last clause still points at `scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` and is **not** expanded into a list of refused forms. The earlier sentence in the same section that points at the same file (「⛔ **它今天拒绝哪些形态不写在这里** —— 以 … 为准」) is kept as well: `grep -c '它今天拒绝' AGENTS.md` = 2.

## Placement, with one line of context on each side

```text
  写错的路径 / 相对错目录的路径 → 非零退出,而不是「跑了 0 个文件然后绿」。
- **`-t` 是正则,不是字面量(objectui#9660)。** 本仓的 `describe` 名普遍以 `(objectui#NNNN)`
  结尾,整段复制粘贴进 `-t`,那对括号就成了捕获组 —— 一个测试都匹配不到,而「名字过滤零匹配」
  在 vitest 里算 **skipped、不算失败**:`Tests 22 skipped (22)` + **退出码 0**。文件过滤是匹配上
  了的,所以上一条的 `passWithNoTests` 在这里什么都管不到,屏幕上也没有任何 `0 tests matched`。
  于是「跑一下那条具名 pin 看过没过」得到的是一个**假绿**。正确写法两种:把元字符转义
  (`-t 'not prose \(objectui#7733\)'`),或者只取名字里一段**不含元字符的子串**
  (`-t 'are derived, not prose'`)。⛔ 别按退出码读结论 —— 读「passed 的计数不是 0」。
  这一形态现已由 `scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` 直接拒绝;⛔ 它今天拒绝哪些形态同样不写在这里,
  以 `scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` 为准。
- 确需从包目录启动,把 root 显式指回仓根:`pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/PKG/`
```

In the last context line above, the file's own angle-bracket placeholder is written here as `PKG`, because GitHub strips tag-shaped fragments from PR bodies. That line of the file is not changed.

## Line budget

- `AGENTS.md`: 591 lines before and 600 after (`wc -l`). `git diff --numstat` shows 9 added and 0 deleted for `AGENTS.md`, and `git diff --stat` shows `1 file changed, 9 insertions(+)`.
- Nothing else is in the diff.

## The two sentences about the guard, re-checked on this branch's base

The base is `a707197`, which was origin/main when the branch was cut. `AGENTS.md` is byte-identical between the dispatch's `961ceaa` and `a707197` (`git diff --stat` on that path is empty). The same-day `d05fe17` landing is in a different section.

- `scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` is on the base: `git cat-file -e` exits 0, and a made-up path used as a negative control exits 128. Its header has 「## Trap 4 — a `-t` name filter read as a REGEX (objectui#9660)」, and its code returns verdict code `unmatchable-name-pattern` for such a pattern.
- `scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` is on the base (exit 0) and passed in the test run below.
- The guard's own exported judge, `judgeNamePattern`, on the card's three spellings:
  - the pasted title `not prose (objectui#7733)` gives `vacuous`, so it is refused;
  - the escaped form gives `null`, so it is allowed;
  - the substring without metacharacters, `are derived, not prose`, gives `null`, so it is allowed.

  So 「这一形态现已由 … 直接拒绝」 is true today, and so are both 「正确写法」.

## Governed surface: this PR stays DRAFT

`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test AGENTS.md` exits 3 and prints 「⛔ GOVERNED — 1 of 1 path(s) are on a governed surface」. This PR needs an APPROVED review from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`). The implementing agent does not flip it to ready, add it to the queue, turn on auto-merge, or approve it.

## No changeset, because the gate says none is owed

`node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exits 0 and prints 「✅  No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.」 `AGENTS.md` is not in any package's published files. The dispatch expected an empty-frontmatter changeset. The gate is the authority on that, and leaving it out keeps the diff at +9 lines in one file.

## Local gates, run at HEAD `1cb7d12`

The gate list was derived by hand from this repo's `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`: each gate whose script reads `AGENTS.md`, plus the ones that read every diff.

| command | exit | printed verdict |
|---|---|---|

| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only -> exit 0` (Files compared: 1; all synthetic controls PASS) |

| `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --changed AGENTS.md` | 0 | Prints `AGENTS.md`: the file is a recorded test input. `--audit` exits 0 (`102 candidate test files, all adjudicated`). |

**Tests.** From the repo root, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` ran over 32 files, through the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). The files are:

- every `scripts/__tests__` file that names `AGENTS.md`;
- the files the `markdown-test-inputs` ledger lists as readers of `AGENTS.md` and of `./*`;
- the guard's own test.

Result: `Test Files  32 passed (32)` and `Tests  1173 passed (1173)`.

**Changeset claim re-read.** Five pending changesets cite this file, and each cites a part this PR does not touch:

- `10106-settled-schema-equal-payload.md` cites §5 commandment #10;
- `6357-basechema-bind-declaration.md` and `6505-predicate-valued-gate-rules.md` cite §4;
- `7122-spec-17-3-0-parity-reconciliation.md` and `7714-lookup-draft-stays-client-side.md` cite the version-alignment rule.

None of them refers to the vitest-invocation section, so this addition makes none of them false.

**Not run locally.** `pnpm lint` belongs to CI. `eslint.config.js` has no `.md` glob and no markdown processor, so eslint reads nothing in this diff.

## Acceptance notes

- No out-of-scope findings.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:在 `AGENTS.md`「怎么跑测试」那一节,一字不改地补回 9 行说明,讲的是:用 `-t` 按测试名过滤时,`-t` 收的是正则,不是字面量。本仓的测试名大多以 `(objectui#NNNN)` 结尾,整段粘进 `-t` 后一个测试都不跑,命令却照样以退出码 0 结束,看上去是「通过」。这 9 行原本随 PR objectui#9730 写好,因为这个文件是受管面,当时被拿掉了。本 PR 只把它放回原来的位置,别的什么都没改。

**为什么改**:守卫脚本现在会直接拒绝这种写法,但报错只告诉你「不行」,不解释为什么「退出码 0」不能当成通过。后者恰恰是 agent 做验证时最常犯的错:看到绿就报通过,其实一个测试都没跑。有了这段说明,agent 读规程时就知道要看「通过的测试数不是 0」,而不能只看退出码。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只加文字,不影响代码、构建或发版;changeset 门禁的判定是本次无需发版声明。最后一句只指向测试文件,没有列出清单,以后守卫改了,这里也不会过时。回滚:revert 这一个提交,删掉的就只是这 9 行。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:请维护者本人(`os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong`)审阅并批准本 PR。批准之后,由认领席翻 ready、入队落地。
